title: nf-core/gwasqc pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input. One row declares one stratum: a PLINK 1 bed/bim/fam fileset that is quality-controlled independently of every other row.

id.description: Unique stratum identifier; used as the output prefix of every file the stratum produces.
id.errorMessage: Stratum id must be provided, must be unique across the samplesheet and cannot contain spaces

ancestry.description: Ancestry label of the stratum, such as EUR, AFR or CSA; carried through as meta.ancestry.
ancestry.errorMessage: Ancestry must be provided, must start with a letter or digit and may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots and dashes

bed.description: PLINK 1 binary genotype file of the stratum; must share its basename with the bim and fam files.
bed.errorMessage: PLINK 1 genotype file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bed'

bim.description: PLINK 1 extended MAP file accompanying the bed file.
bim.errorMessage: PLINK 1 variant file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bim'

fam.description: PLINK 1 sample information file accompanying the bed file.
fam.errorMessage: PLINK 1 sample file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fam'
